controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-postgresql.log-*
| WHERE host.name == "db-1" AND @timestamp >= "2026-07-06T20:03:30.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-06T21:03:30.000Z"
        AND log.level == "FATAL"
| STATS count = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY user.name
| SORT count DESC
